name: order_urine_culture
description: Orders a urine culture with antibiotic sensitivity testing. Identifies specific bacterial pathogens causing urinary tract infection and determines effective antibiotics. Colony count thresholds help distinguish true infection from contamination.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering urine culture

when_to_use: Confirmed or suspected UTI requiring pathogen identification
Complicated UTI (pregnant, male, catheterized, structural abnormality)
Pyuria on urinalysis with negative dipstick
